body:
Investigated "multiplayer has never worked for me" rather than guessing.
The earlier server-deployment fix (BPMM-12441/12442, 2026-09-04) was real
and is confirmed live right now. The actual remaining gap: apps/lobby's
SERVER_HOST defaulted to 127.0.0.1, so a compiled client run on any machine
other than the server's own -- every real player -- silently tried to
matchmake against itself with nothing listening there. No error anywhere.

Real fix: new DNS A record brawlpit.okemily.com -> 198.58.107.85 (created
via the real Cloudflare API), now the client's default. Live-verified
genuinely external to loopback: a hand-crafted PACKET_FIND_MATCH UDP
packet sent to the public hostname got back a real PACKET_QUEUE_STATUS
reply with the correct queue depth. scripts/build.sh still clean.

Real, honest, not solved: cross-NAT traversal between two genuinely
different networks is untested (this was one client on the same host
talking to the public address, not two remote players) -- named as the
real next verification step if the founder still can't connect.

Commit: BRAWLPIT 77e50ce.

⚓ ☃
title: Fixed the real reason BRAWLPIT multiplayer never worked: SERVER_HOST defaulted to loopback
